🏕️ Katar, Sholo Guti, Atharah Guti & Terah Tehni

Leap-and-capture war games across 6×6 grids, 2-camp Sholo Guti, 4-camp 49-node Atharah Guti (20v20), and open-center Terah Tehni (13v13).

🧠 Navakankari, Lasker, Saat Guti, Picaria & Dara

Form 3-in-a-row Katars across 9/10/12-Men, Lasker Morris (drop or slide from Turn 1), 17-node Saat Guti, 13-node Picaria (no Turn-1 center drop), and 5×6 Dara.

🐅 Bagh-Chal, Sher-Bakar, Rimau-Rimau & 🦊 Fox & Geese

Asymmetric predator hunts! Sher-Bakar leaps 1–3 aligned Goats, Rimau-Rimau pits 2 Tigers vs 22 Goats, and 15 Geese march strictly forward/sideways against 2 Foxes.

🦋 Lau Kata Kati, ☸️ Pretwa & ☸️ Gol Ekuish (33-Node)

Butterfly and circular radial wheel boards: sweep enemy beads around unbroken concentric circular rings in Pretwa (19-node) and Gol Ekuish (33-node 16v16).

⚔️ Fanorona, 🛡️ Seega & 🛡️ Tablut Royal Escort

Fanorona: Approach & Withdrawal line captures. Seega: Orthogonal sandwich captures. Tablut: Escort the King to a corner while dodging 16 Ambushers!

👑 Dama / Turkish Dama • 🔥 Pente • ⭕ Yavalath • ⚡ Connect6

Turkish Dama: Orthogonal Flying Sultan Kings. Pente: 5-in-a-row or 5 pair captures. Yavalath: Hex 4 wins, 3 loses! Connect6: 2 stones/turn for 6-in-a-row.

⏳ Mid-Game Leave / Disconnect Forfeit Rule: If a player leaves, closes the game, or disconnects mid-match, a known return countdown (default 60s) starts automatically. If they do not return before the countdown expires, victory is awarded to the remaining player!
